label: File identity and provenance
what_is_established: hash, manifest, version, and byte identity

label: Output-level numerical traceability
what_is_established: consistency with a designated stored artifact

label: Re-execution from specified inputs
what_is_established: a stored result can be recalculated with an identified implementation

label: Descriptive agreement across sources
what_is_established: alignment or compatibility among source summaries
what_is_not_automatic: common cause or formal joint significance

label: Implementation-diversity validation
what_is_established: recovery by a separately written implementation or genuinely separate workflow
what_is_not_automatic: external independent replication or causal identification

label: Causal attribution
what_is_established: alternative causes discriminated by a suitable test
